topic: What if you could see one minute ahead?
title: WHAT IF YOU COULD
SEE ONE MINUTE AHEAD?

power.rule: you see the next sixty seconds, every time you want
power.look: the picture goes cool and ghostly, a +60s chip and a stopwatch running forward; the future plays as a cyan ghost

script.text: Last cookie. Peek. Your friend takes it. So you grab it first.
A paper ball. Peek. You duck.
Your best friend opens his mouth. Peek. You answer before he asks.
What if you could see one minute ahead?

script.beat: 4 the turn: the cost, one real fact
script.text: One catch: your brain already burns a fifth of your body's energy. That's real. Now it's running two minutes at once.

science.claim: Your brain already burns a fifth of your body's energy.
science.working: The adult brain is about 2% of body mass but accounts for about 20% of the body's resting energy use (oxygen and glucose consumption), roughly 20 W of a resting ~100 W. 20% = one fifth.
science.source: Raichle & Gusnard, 'Appraising the brain's energy budget', PNAS 99 (2002) 10237-10239

science.claim: Now it's running two minutes at once.
science.working: Story premise, not a claim of fact: the hero's brain processes the present and the minute ahead together. Stated as fiction after 'That's real.'
